title: Top 30 New Feature Recommendations (v8, beyond v7's 205 features)
selection_criteria: Priority P1, high or medium expected gain, low sym_robust concern, easy or medium complexity

features.name: ofi_ts_zscore_W5_W60
features.why: Top SHAP feature in HFT execution models; captures OFI relative to sym's own rolling baseline rather than cross-sym. Orthogonal to all v7 cross-sym OFI features.

features.name: obi_trade_filtered_W5
features.source: LOB Filtration Anantha et al. 2025 arxiv:2507.22712
features.why: OBI from trade events only has stronger causal link to price moves than full LOB OFI. Empirically superior in 2025 study. Requires tick-rule trade direction labeling.

features.name: signed_amt_imb_W20
features.source: Easley 2024 updated VPIN / Jane Street RTMDF
features.why: Dollar-weighted signed imbalance (amount × sign) vs. quantity-weighted OFI. Captures large institutional trades more accurately. Easy to implement from amount field.

features.name: trade_sign_imb_W5
features.why: Direct tick-rule signed volume imbalance from Jane Street's production system. Top signal in competition winning solutions. Simpler and more direct than LOB-derived OFI.

features.name: rv_5tick
features.formula: sum((logret_k)^2 for k in last 5 ticks)
features.why: Ultra-short realized variance is orthogonal to W20 and W60 RV features in v7. Captures micro-volatility regime that drives short-horizon mean-reversion.

features.name: rv_acceleration
features.why: Ratio of recent micro-vol to baseline captures vol regime transitions. High ratio = volatility breakout. Not in v7 (v7 only has absolute RV values, not ratios).

features.name: har_vol_composite
features.why: HAR (Heterogeneous AutoRegressive) combination of multi-scale RV is proven predictor of future vol. Captures different trading horizons simultaneously.

features.name: microprice_L3_corr
features.formula: microprice_L1 + a2*(imb2-imb1) + a3*(imb3-imb2), a_k frozen from training
features.why: Error-corrected microprice using deeper book info is more accurate fair-value estimate. Correction coefficients a2, a3 are frozen scalars from training. Should improve over L1-only microprice.

features.name: microprice_residual_L1_L3
features.why: The deep-book correction term itself is an independent signal: large positive residual means L2/L3 bid pressure supports an upward correction beyond L1 estimate.

features.name: ofi_x_spread_W5
features.source: Feature Interactions Beutel et al. 2025 arxiv:2510.04543
features.why: OFI × spread captures the interaction between order flow pressure and liquidity cost. High OFI in a wide-spread market means more informed activity. Simple product not in v7.

features.name: ofi_x_rv_W20
features.source: Feature Interactions Beutel et al. 2025 arxiv:2510.04543
features.why: OFI modulated by volatility level. High-volatility OFI is noisier; low-vol OFI is more informative. This interaction captures regime-dependent OFI signal quality.

features.name: imb1_x_rv_W20
features.source: Feature Interactions Beutel et al. 2025 arxiv:2510.04543
features.why: Imbalance × vol captures the price impact of current queue imbalance given volatility regime. Should be highly predictive for short-horizon mid-price changes.

features.name: ofi_depth_interaction_W5
features.source: T2G-Former Yan et al. 2023 AAAI arxiv:2211.16887
features.why: OFI per unit depth = instantaneous price impact intensity (Kyle lambda proxy). Different from frozen kyleinv (F016) in that it uses current depth not historical estimate.

features.name: csec_iqr_norm_ret_W5
features.why: IQR normalization is more robust to outlier syms than std-based z-score in v7. When one sym has extreme move, IQR normalization avoids distorting all others.

features.name: csec_iqr_norm_ofi_W5
features.why: IQR-normalized OFI complements IQR-normalized return. Robust cross-sym z-score that won't be distorted by outlier OFI values.

features.name: cross_impact_adj_ofi_W5
features.formula: OFI_W5[i] + sum_j(gamma_ij * sign(OFI_W5[j]) * sqrt(abs(OFI_W5[j]))), gamma_ij frozen
features.why: Concave (sqrt) cross-impact adjustment respects square-root market impact law. Better than linear cross-OFI. The gamma_ij matrix is small (5×5) and frozen from training.

features.name: self_impact_concave_W5
features.why: Concave self-impact of OFI fits market data better than linear OFI. Large OFI values get discounted; small OFI values get amplified. Drop-in replacement for raw OFI.

features.name: ofi_pca1_W5
features.formula: dot(OFI_L1..5_W5, pc1_weights) where pc1 frozen from training
features.why: First PC of 5-level OFI explains 89% of variance. Optimal linear combination of multi-level OFI is better than any single level. Frozen PC weights are easy to precompute.

features.name: ofi_pca1_W20
features.formula: dot(OFI_L1..5_W20, pc1_weights) where pc1 frozen from training
features.why: Medium-horizon version of PCA-integrated OFI. Complements W5 version for different prediction horizons.

features.name: pin_proxy_W20
features.why: Unsigned trade imbalance as PIN proxy captures informed trading probability. Different from OFI (signed) and OBI (aggressive only). Complements both.

features.name: ofi_factor_ratio_W5
features.source: Multi-Asset OFI Eisler et al. 2021 QF
features.why: Ratio normalization by market mean captures relative OFI importance including sign. Different from additive demean (F078) — multiplicative ratio has better scale invariance.

features.name: ofi_idiosyncratic_W5
features.source: Multi-Asset OFI Eisler et al. 2021 QF
features.why: Two-factor OFI decomposition: common (market) factor removed. This idiosyncratic component predicts asset-specific returns better than raw OFI. Refined version of F078.

features.name: amihud_realized_W20
features.formula: sum(abs(logret_k)/(tick_volume_k+eps) for k in W20) / W20
features.why: Realized Amihud is much more precise than classic Amihud for intraday liquidity. Not in v7. Provides complementary information to spread and Kyle lambda.

features.name: csec_amihud_zscore
features.why: Cross-sym Amihud z-score: which sym has anomalously high/low price impact today. New liquidity dimension not captured by spread or depth features in v7.

features.name: delta_cross_logret_W5_W20
features.formula: logret_W5[i] - logret_W20[j] for frozen best lead-lag pair j
features.source: DeltaLag Zhou et al. 2025 arxiv:2511.00390 ICAIF
features.why: DeltaLag showed this asymmetric-window cross-return feature substantially outperforms fixed symmetric pairs. Frozen pair assignment from training avoids sym-specificity at test time.

features.name: lagged_cross_iofi_W5
features.formula: ofi_pca1_W5[j] for fixed best lagged-impact pair j (frozen from training)
features.source: Cross-Impact OFI Kolm et al. 2023 QF
features.why: Lagged cross-OFI (not contemporaneous) improves return forecasting per Kolm 2023. The 'j' that most predicts sym i's return is identified during training and frozen.

features.name: csec_demean_trade_imb_W5
features.why: Market-neutralized trade imbalance. Removes common buy/sell pressure across all 5 syms, isolating sym-specific informed trading signal.

features.name: csec_demean_microprice_L3
features.why: Market-neutral deep microprice: uses L3-corrected fair value and removes cross-sym commonality. More accurate than v7's F085 (which uses L1-only microprice).

features.name: vol_gated_ofi_W5
features.why: Dampen OFI signal during high-volatility periods when OFI is noisier. Empirically validated in TFT-GNN architecture as gating mechanism.

features.name: microprice_x_ofi_W5
features.why: Microprice excess × OFI: when microprice already leans bullish AND OFI confirms buying pressure, the combined signal is stronger than either alone. Interaction effect.

implementation_notes.nf018_microprice_L3_corr: Precompute a2, a3 via OLS regression on training data: regress (fair_price - microprice_L1) on (imb2-imb1, imb3-imb2). Freeze coefficients.
implementation_notes.nf020_obi_trade_filtered: Use tick rule on trade price to assign buy/sell direction. Then compute imbalance over W5 ticks using only trade events (not LOB updates).
implementation_notes.nf022_ofi_pca1_W5: Compute OFI at levels 1-5, stack into matrix, run PCA on training data. Freeze first 2 PC weight vectors.
implementation_notes.nf076_delta_cross: Identify best lag-pair (j, i) from training data using cross-correlation analysis. Freeze assignment. At test time, simply compute logret_W5[i] - logret_W20[j].
implementation_notes.nf082_cross_impact_adj: Fit 5×5 gamma matrix via ridge regression on training data. At test time: matrix multiply.
